dedupe_keys.name: the dataset of photovoltaic power plant distribution in china by 2020

description: Henan University publishes a national map of photovoltaic power-plant extent in China for 2020. The research team classified Landsat imagery on Google Earth Engine with a Random Forest model and then refined the map by visual interpretation. The repository reports a mapped photovoltaic area of 2,917 square kilometres. It lists separate ZIP archives for the resulting map and training samples, available openly under CC-BY-4.0 at no cost. The input imagery has 30 m resolution; the archive’s internal encoding was not inspected. A limitation is that mapped panel area is not an electrical capacity measurement, and rooftop systems or small installations may require finer imagery and independent checks. A modeller could overlay these footprints with floods, land constraints or transmission proximity when forming generation scenarios. The 2020 snapshot complements data-chinapv-10m-2024 as a different time and resolution product. Their classifications and coverage must be reconciled before interpreting changes as actual construction or removal.
